item.title: modulestf
item.description: Agent skills for Claude Code and Codex that review, fix and maintain reusable Terraform modules by the rules of terraform-aws-modules. Rules: modules.tf/rules.

item.title: mtf-facts
item.description: Offline Go CLI that parses Terraform module trees and reports rule results, findings with evidence, and interface and provider schema diffs. Works as a standalone module linter.

item.title: repro-lambda
item.description: Builds byte-identical AWS Lambda packages on macOS and Linux, uploads them to S3 by content hash, and passes them to terraform-aws-lambda as s3existingpackage, so terraform plan builds nothing.

item.title: terraform-provider-aws (compliance.tf)
item.description: AWS provider for Terraform and OpenTofu by compliance.tf. Runs the unmodified hashicorp/aws provider and checks aws resources against compliance controls before apply. Warns by default; can fail the run in CI.

item.title: ctfkit
item.description: Offline analyzer for Terraform and OpenTofu configuration, plans and module manifests. Writes SARIF findings. Needs no cloud credentials. Also available as a GitHub Action.
